data.desc: Klaviyo (CLAY-vee-oh) is an autonomous B2C CRM that powers more valuable customer experiences. We unify a flexible, scalable data platform, intelligence that gets smarter with every interaction, and action across Marketing and Service to help businesses turn real-time customer data into personalization at scale. High-growth enterprises like Mattel, TaylorMade, Glossier, Liquid Death, Daily Harvest and more than 205,000 other paying customers leverage Klaviyo's actionable infrastructure and our more than 350 integrations to deliver measurable outcomes through faster, higher-quality experiences.
